frozen_pool.distance_tie_break: target node id, then cKDTree index

n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.background: the crop median is subtracted, then negative residuals are clamped to zero
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.certificate: the reverse transported position's nearest frozen source detection must be the originating source; ties use node id
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.name: NDR-FBC-local-translation-v1
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.observable: raw intensity only; local robust intensity-centroid translation from t to t+1 and reverse local centroid translation from offered target to t
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.offer_policy: every nonterminal baseline node with no selected outgoing edge produces at most one offer; duplicates in frozen pool are discarded
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.target_choice: nearest frozen detection in physical z/y/x to forward raw-intensity transport; ties use node id
n1_minimum_viable_mechanism.thresholds_or_fitting: none; windows, median subtraction, and one-offer policy are fixed before target evaluation

negative_fixtures.empty_foreground: local raw translation raises EmptyForegroundError rather than emitting an offer
negative_fixtures.label_shuffled_target: evaluator rejects a target whose canonical SHA-256 differs from target_sha256
negative_fixtures.permuted_frame: validator rejects any non-adjacent or non-manifest frame mapping before raw registration

purpose: Preregistered fit-only N2 evaluator target; candidate generator receives no target labels.
slice_rule: lexicographically first twelve 6bba identities in the H1 fit105 source; every raw frame 0..99, hence every adjacent pair 0->1 through 98->99; no video subsampling
target_definition: All adjacent-frame GT continuation edges on this slice that are absent from selected baseline truth edges and absent from frozen 10-um/cap-8 pool; endpoint-unmatched targets remain in denominator because the supplier must not assume complete prediction endpoints.
